provenance: Rig, bind pose and clip measurements: Actor_B. Clip names keep their native asset ids in the animation library.

conventions.space: bind pose null-add; 'stow.local' is the model transform in the carrying bone's rest frame (Godot variant text: basis rows then origin); 'stow.bind' is the same in skeleton space
conventions.model_axes: WeaponModels / ThrowableModels: firearms and spears -Z = muzzle / point, +Y = top; bow +Y = upper limb, string +Z; tomahawk +Y = haft to head, -Z = edge; atlatl +Z = to the hook; dart origin = tip, +Z = to the nock; quiver (new) origin = mouth, +Y = out of the mouth
conventions.angles: 0 front, 90 character right, 180 back, 270 left (about the skeleton Y axis)
conventions.attach: rigid = the bone's pose; two_anchor = hook on the bone, direction from a skinned second anchor at 70 % of the item (body-fit survey)

R_hip.pistol.basis: revision 3 pick y_dz5_rhip_a090t45 (among placements with surface and non-forearm limbs at worst contact (>= -3.5 cm) in play: nearest to the source grab (standing grip gap, then rotation); the forearm / hand swing is reported separately)
R_hip.pistol.note: Hooked on the belt at the right side seam (90 deg, where the old horn sat and the source draw reaches): belt hook on the left flat of the stock, so the lock faces out; the barrel hangs down the hip with the muzzle tilted 45 deg toward the front along the belt, the butt lies back along the belt. Two-anchor, and it yields to the limbs (swings on its hook, at most 30 deg).

pre_contact.motion: pendulum about the belt normal through the hook (no roll about the barrel)

handoff.note: phases are fractions of the draw clip, so they scale with the rate (quick = x2)

horn.powder_horn.note: Behind the right hip above the pistol butt, plug toward the spine, spout forward to the right side; on its strap over the left shoulder it swings clear of the arm (yield). Knox 1757 hangs it under the right arm: that place clips the swinging upper arm (-6.3 cm even when yielding).

legacy_baked_belt.note: The leather waist belt baked into assets/character/actor_b_body.glb (Gear). Default waist gear.
legacy_baked_belt.evidence: A (belt, Doddridge [P3]); B (R_hip: a pistol hooked in a waist belt by a belt hook on the left side of the stock, sea-service practice [W2][W3]); C (L_hip: see the point's own grade)

belt_tied_behind.note: Knot and short ends at the back (175-185 deg): the back item sits at 200 deg and back_left holds nothing; the knife goes on the shot-pouch strap.

sash_fingerwoven.note: Wide band (y 0.90-1.06) tied at the left hip: the knot blocks L_hip; a second pistol goes horizontally through the sash behind the right hip (the graph's default pistol stow), which takes the back point.
sash_fingerwoven.evidence: A (sash) [M7c]; C (back_right: a pistol pushed horizontally through the sash behind the hip is a modern-looking carry; the period front tuck was measured and rejected, thighs -9 to -11 cm, design_fit_check.json revision.sash_front)

as_shoulder.note: Worn as a baldric over the right shoulder: its hanging end at the left hip carries one item. Adds L_hip only when the waist gear lacks it (a sash).

military_waist_belt.note: Buff waist belt with the cartridge pouch at the front (330-30 deg): no front items.

br_belts_cartridge.note: Cartridge box on the shoulder belt behind the right hip blocks R_hip; a pistol can hook on the shoulder belt at the right chest.
br_belts_cartridge.evidence: A (belts, bible 5.6); C (a pistol hooked on the shoulder belt: no source for regulars)

pistol_sling.note: New gear built by the loadout workflow: a leather or silk sling over the right shoulder to the left hip with two pistol hooks / small holsters on the chest.
pistol_sling.evidence: B for one pistol hung by its belt hook from a thin shoulder belt at the left side (Highland soldiers of the 42nd in the French and Indian War wore one steel pistol under the left arm on a thin buff belt [W1]); C for the second pistol (a sling with three brace of pistols in holsters: Blackbeard, 1718, Johnson 1724 [W4])

horn_strap.note: Horn behind and below the right arm on a strap over the left shoulder (Knox 1757); customizer-owned mesh.

shot_pouch_strap.note: Pouch at the left hip on a strap over the right shoulder; a sheath knife may ride on it.

back_slings.note: The long weapons bring their own slings (musket sling, bow string across the chest, a thong for the spear pair or the dart bundle, the quiver strap). The pack's tool loop (tool_loop) takes one gathering tool, head down with its haft up behind the right shoulder (GatherTools draws it; data/gathering/gathering.json carry).
back_slings.evidence: B (slung muskets, bows and quivers on the back)

back_load.note: A load on the back takes the upper right back: long_B and the quiver (the quiver would sit inside the pack). With a back load the bow cannot be carried slung (it needs long_B and the quiver).

pistol_cap_note: a game cap (two braces), not a documented maximum: Johnson (1724) gives Blackbeard three brace (six) on one sling. Per gear the table of loadout_design.md 1.4 is a MAXIMUM; the usable number after the other items is effective_pistol_capacity() (LoadoutRules)

yield.rule: an item with yield_deg > 0 hangs from a hook or strap: each frame it swings about its hook (first capsule origin) away from any limb capsule that would pass into it, by the smallest angle up to yield_deg, never deeper into the body; smoothed over 0.08 s (measure_body_fit.gd 'yield')

order_inner_to_outer: body (horn, belt pistol, back tomahawk / atlatl)
back_layering.rule: standoff(item) = max over the items under it of standoff(under) + extra(under, item); applied as a rotation about the item's upper contact (the shoulder) so that the crossing point gets its standoff, not as a translation of the whole item

sling_all_finish.deviation: the graph's standing finish row is the draw clip itself, which walks the empty hand into the pistol carry pose; hands free uses the stow clip in both stances (design_fit_check.json revision.holster_finish)

pistol_no_pack_mirrored.status: source-derived (mirrored copy to build), then pass_left_to_right

pass_left_to_right.status: source clip played backwards (forward it passes right -> left)
pass_left_to_right.note: reversed: the right hand closes at 0.10 s, the left lets go at 0.25 s (stand)

throwable_back.next: equip (take the next one from the belt, throwables design: 0.5 s)

long_gun_left.hand: left, passes to the right at 0.25-0.40 s

sling_all_finish.deviation: the standing finish row is the bow draw, which ends with the empty left hand 42 cm in front of the pelvis in the bow carry; hands free uses the stow clip

reach_right_shoulder.status: source segment (bow nock clip: the right hand over the right shoulder); for arrows and darts it is the whole take; for a spear pair or a musket on long_B the carry that follows is a SYNTHETIC crossfade (no source clip carries a long item off the right shoulder)
reach_right_shoulder.note: the hand passes the quiver mouth / upper ends at 0.3-0.4 s; the item appears in the hand there

reach_left_shoulder.status: source segment (first 0.25 s of the long-gun draw)
